place: Council Chambers, Municipal Hall, 37955 Second Avenue
agenda_place: Council Chambers, Municipal Hall, 37955 Second Avenue
preview: Council meets at noon to talk about the District's budget for 2027 to 2036 and decide what goes into it. Before that, council plans to close part of the meeting to the public to discuss staff, legal and labour matters.

agenda_items.plain: Council will decide which day to day costs, special projects, building projects and proposed service changes go into the District's 10 year budget for 2027 to 2036.
agenda_items.ask: Should the District include the operating budgets, capital budgets, proposed service changes and special projects presented by staff in its 2027 to 2036 budget?
agenda_items.yes_means: Staff will build these spending items into the draft budget, which still needs more votes before it becomes final.
agenda_items.no_means: Staff will not add these items as presented, and council would need to give different direction on what the budget should contain.
agenda_items.context: The Financial Plan is the District's 10 year budget. It sets what the town spends on daily services, special projects and building projects, and it shapes how much property tax residents pay. This step pulls the earlier budget pieces together. The budget still has to go through bylaw readings and adoption, and a separate tax rate bylaw comes after that.
facts: Includes the general operating, special operating and capital budgets
Includes proposed service level changes that council has not yet endorsed
Includes proposed special projects that council has not yet endorsed
supporters: Staff say this report brings all the budget pieces together in one place
Agreeing on the contents now lets staff prepare the budget bylaw for adoption
Service changes and special projects can still be endorsed or changed later
concerns: Spending choices made here affect the size of the property tax increase
Some service changes and projects are still waiting for council endorsement
Cutting items may delay services or projects some residents want
factors: Size of next year's property tax increase
Building and repairing roads, pipes and facilities
Projects that may be delayed or dropped
agenda_items.for_you: The choices in this budget will shape the property tax bill on every home in Squamish starting in 2027.

agenda_items.plain: Council will meet in private to discuss staff positions, labour relations, legal matters and lawsuits, legal advice, and goals for the District's annual report.
